dedupe_keys.name: european gas grid and hydrogen retrofit module

description: This ModelBlocks module creates aggregated European gas networks and hydrogen-retrofit inputs through a Snakemake workflow. It processes SciGRID gas data, estimates capacities and aggregates pipelines and salt-cavern storage to user polygons. The provider is ModelBlocks contributors. Coverage: Europe. Offshore hubs and external-country terminals can be represented; reference years depend on upstream sources. Access: The public repository documents configuration and importing the module into Snakemake. The workflow and its automatic downloads were not executed. Licence and cost: The repository shows Apache 2.0 and points to separate attribution for borrowed algorithms and source data. Limitations: Some pipeline capacities are imputed and depend on aggregation assumptions. Independent reuse or sustained maintenance was not established. For simulation it prepares capacity-constrained gas and hydrogen network inputs for other energy-system models. Related resources: The module explicitly processes data-scigrid-gas and estimates attributes; its outputs must retain those derivation assumptions.
